intro.text: A monastery where Shin acolytes train under the Elsecaller Honorbearer.

description.text: Narrow-windowed corridors connect the great hall to shared sleeping rooms. Metal handles and stone floors accustom acolytes to materials other Shin avoid touching.
The monastery stands in Mokdown, a city on an island between two rivers. Its Honorbearer appoints officials in the city's government.

items.text: Pozen recruited Szeth as an acolyte and brought him to the monastery.
Szeth defeated the resident swordsmaster. Rather than remain in line for the Elsecaller Blade, he was sent on a pilgrimage to prepare for the Windrunner Blade.
After visiting the Voice, Szeth returned at night to confront Sivi about what he had seen.
Pozen drew Szeth into Shadesmar and killed himself, leaving Szeth without an easy way back.
Szeth revisited the acolytes' rooms with Kaladin and Syl. Their search found that most of the shamans had been sent to the Bondsmith monastery.
